name: Language Toolkit
description: Master the Java Collections mindset and C++ STL habits you need before DSA through a step-by-step ladder: dynamic arrays, strings and builders, maps and sets, queues and deques, heaps, and sorting or iteration helpers.
roadmap: Hash maps: frequency, seen sets, index mapping
Deque expiry and monotonic deque patterns
Priority queues and top-k heap decisions
Sorting helpers and collection iteration fluency
